reproduce: xcrun llvm-objdump --macho --disassemble --dis-symname SYMBOL LIBRARY_PATH; otool -l LIBRARY_PATH
interpretation: DAF directory supplies INIT, INTLEN, RSIZE and N. Separate binary64 subtraction then division; signed truncation equals floor for nonnegative quotient. One-based record is min(trunc(q_hat)+1,N), followed by integer DAF addressing. MADD here is integer, not floating-point FMA.

evaluation_instructions.instruction: chbval: fnmsub d2, d1, d2, d4
chbval: fnmsub d0, d0, d2, d3
chbint: fnmsub d6, d1, d6, d16
chbint: fnmsub d3, d0, d6, d3

evaluation_scope: Inspected positive-degree position recurrence in chbval_ and chbint_. Each product-minus-previous term is fused, followed by a separate coefficient addition. SPKE03 calls chbval_ for six stored components; SPKE02 calls chbint_ for three position polynomials and derivatives. Only the position recurrence is replayed; derivative arithmetic is not qualified by it.
scope: Static successful reader and position-evaluation paths in this exact build. Assumes valid directory, nonnegative finite in-range quotient, no signed integer overflow and declared floating-point mode. Does not certify live dispatch, continuous FPCR, DAF internals, segment priority, polynomial evaluation error, center-chain summation or spacecraft safety.
